name: Colon MobileNetV3-Small, Hibou-B-distilled

provenance.dataset: NCT-CRC-HE-100K-NONORM (train) + CRC-VAL-HE-7K halves (valid / test), CC BY 4.0, via Hugging Face 1aurent/NCT-CRC-HE
provenance.training: fine-tuned on colorectal tissue: tumour epithelium vs 8 non-tumour classes (NCT-CRC-HE-100K) (8 epochs, best epoch 8, strong augmentation + EMA, 256-batch)
provenance.distilled_from: hibou-b (foundation model, histai/hibou-b; its own head trained on this dataset)

runtime.runs_on: this clinic PC only: no cloud, no data leaves the clinic (TDD 1.2, 7.1)

measured_per_slide_s.context: median warmed run, 150 patches, batch 16, 4 threads, i5-13400F (150 patches, batch 16, 4 threads, onnxruntime 1.31.0). Same-graph reference: every organ's model is the same MobileNetV3-Small graph as the measured lymph-node model.

plism.metric: share of normal colon patches flagged (P ≥ 0.5)

organ_cancer_on_phones.tissues: normal right colon vs colon adenocarcinoma + metastatic colorectal cancer

other_tissues_false_alarm.note: normal tissue of all organs on phones: only valid for colon

comparison.model: This model: MobileNetV3-Small, distilled from Hibou-B
Same model, trained without the teacher

comparison.note: most accurate, but too large and slow for a clinic CPU

literature.note: Published baselines were not recorded with these runs, so none are quoted: numbers here come only from the evidence files above.

limitations: Trained only on colon tissue. Use it only for colon slides: normal tissue of all PLISM organs was flagged 9%–14% on phones.
Needs a calibrated magnification (issue #35): photos are resized to 0.5 µm/px.
The test half shares patients with the validation half used for the epoch and threshold choices (CRC-VAL-HE-7K has no patient IDs), and its tiles are stain-normalised, unlike training.
Slide thresholds were tuned on slides simulated from validation tiles; re-tune on real captures.
Prioritisation aid only, not a diagnostic engine: every slide must be reviewed by a pathologist (TDD 1.2).
